authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6065 truṭyati explicitly includes Prakrit tuṭṭa broken, Hindi ṭūṭā and Bhojpuri ṭūṭal. The survey ṭuṭā/ṭuṭo/ṭuṭel forms are participial continuations of that verb. Exact survey form ṭuṭo is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.
